headline: PHI @ MIL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is PHI 3.98 at MIL 5.68, with a projected total of 9.67. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward MIL: PHI moved +1.36 runs while MIL moved +2.01, changing the projected margin by -0.65 runs. The projected total climbed +3.37, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -31.3%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Shane Drohan has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Jackson Chourio, Christian Yelich, Brice Turang, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Gabriel Rincones Jr., J.T. Realmuto because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
